posts.title: Emergency crews respond to crash in Weymouth
posts.description: Police and an ambulance crew could be seen working at the scene of a crash in Weymouth overnight. Officers could be seen canvassing a stretch of Bridge Street following the crash. A pair of shoes could be seen in the roadway. No additional information was immediately available. This is a developing news story; stay with 7NEWS on-air and online for the latest details.

posts.title: Police investigating shooting in Jamaica Plain
posts.description: Boston police are investigating a shooting in Jamaica Plain on Friday that left a person hospitalized. Officers responding to a reported shooting on Bickford Street around 8:30 p.m. found a person suffering from a non-life-threatening gunshot wound, according to Boston police. The victim was taken to a nearby hospital. Anyone with information is asked to call Boston police. This is a developing news story; stay with 7NEWS on-air and online for the latest details.

posts.title: Drying out… for now
posts.description: The Thanksgiving storm is behind us… kind of. It’s like a bad ex and simply just doesn’t want to go away for good! Of course the height of the storm was Thanksgiving evening. Then we had that little batch of light rain yesterday evening… yep, same storm. And even today, while it is mostly dry, there’s like a 10% chance of a sprinkle or very light shower… yep, same storm! But, don’t worry too much about that rain chance today. It’s an incredibly low chance, but if you’re out and about this afternoon and feel a couple of drips and drops, that’s what that is. It’s nothing heavy or long lasting. Today will bring a mix of sun and clouds and high temperatures that make it to the lower 50s with a breeze this afternoon. That’s still pretty good for this time of year — average highs are now in the upper 40s. Sunday is the nicer, brighter and less breezy day of the weekend, but I don’t think either day is terrible.
